analyst_view.overall: NEC (12th, 14 points) host FC Twente (3rd, 27 points) on Sunday evening at the Goffertstadion, three days after both played in Europe. Dick Schreuder's NEC beat Rennes 3-1 at home in the Europa League with two late goals, while John van den Brom's Twente lost 2-1 at Freiburg in the Conference League to a stoppage-time rebound, starting the same XI as against Willem II and travelling back from Germany; the numbers have no congestion adjustment for either. Twente's squad is thin, with Unnerstall, Bruns, Thorvaldsen, Van den Belt and Kurowski all out (VI, Twentefans and Voetbalprimeur agree) and only 18 fit outfielders; the numbers count most of these. NEC's Nuytinck, Schuurs and Emre Mor are listed out in the numbers but I found no fresh update, and attacker Dele Thomas was left out against Rennes for disciplinary reasons (one report). Sander van der Eijk's high card record is already counted; my small trims are for the Thursday-Sunday turnaround, heavier for Twente.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, 1.8 for Twente, raised for Twente's 19 goals in their last six and lowered for NEC's absences (Schuurs, Mor). Twente have played the same eleven twice in four days with a thin squad and travelled back from Freiburg, and VI said they struggled to make a difference up front there; the numbers don't see that, so I trim to about 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, 5.2 for NEC, already moved for NEC winning plenty lately (38 in six) and Twente conceding very few. Tired legs could cut attacking volume a little, but corners depend more on how the game goes, so I stay at about 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards, already raised about 20% for Sander van der Eijk (3.6 a game over 55 games). Fatigue after European games can bring late fouls but can also flatten a game, and nothing else points to a heated match, so I stay at about 3.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.6 shots, with a big boost for Twente's 150 shots in their last six (+13.7%). Twente used an unchanged eleven at Freiburg on Thursday with only 18 fit outfielders and NEC also played on Thursday, so either tired legs or rotation should cost some volume; I trim to about 27.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target, raised 10.6% for Twente's sharp recent shooting (55 on target in six). With both sides three days on from European games and Twente stretched, I trim to about 10.2.
